name: troubleshooting
label: Troubleshooting
description: Actuator check: every interval, the selected nodes lower, hold, and raise an empty plate (M2 only, M1 never runs, no pellets). A faulted node is skipped until Recover; the rest keep cycling.

parameters.label: Active nodes
parameters.help: Nodes to cycle; all of them move together

parameters.label: Cycle every (min)
parameters.help: Start of one cycle to the start of the next

parameters.label: Hold at bottom (s)
parameters.help: Time at the drop position before raising (about a fed node's load time); 0 = raise as soon as every node is down
